domain_separator_note: ASCII text followed by exactly one 0x00 byte; 34 bytes; not length-prefixed.
length_prefix: unsigned 32-bit big-endian byte count of the field's encoded bytes
hash: SHA-256 over domain || LP(f1) || ... || LP(f8); represented as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
generator: python3 -I, hashlib.sha256, struct.pack('>I'), str.encode('utf-8','strict'); independent of the .NET implementation

valid.description: Non-ASCII UTF-8: precomposed (NFC) tenant with 2-byte characters; schema ID with a 2-byte and a 4-byte (surrogate-pair) character.
Same visible text as V02 tenant but decomposed (NFD: u+U+0308, e+U+0301). No normalization, so the bytes and the hash differ from V02.
Version-label-only change from V01 (field 5 1.0.0 -> 1.0.1; field 4 unchanged).
VersionId-only change from V01 (field 4 1.0.0 -> 1.0.1; field 5 unchanged).
Published-version change as Records produces it today (fields 4 and 5 both 1.0.1; RecordTypeDefinitionStore.cs:613-615).
Body-digest-only change from V01 (field 7, different BodyJson).
Field-boundary ambiguity, side A: record_type_id 'sales.customer1' + version_id '1.0.0'. Plain concatenation of fields 3||4 is 'sales.customer11.0.0'.
Field-boundary ambiguity, side B: record_type_id 'sales.customer' + version_id '11.0.0'. Plain concatenation of every field equals V09's; the length prefixes differ, so the hashes differ.
Trailing whitespace is content: tenant 'acme ' (U+0020 appended). No trimming; differs from V01.
Case is content: tenant 'Acme'. No case folding; differs from V01.
A U+0000 inside a field is ordinary content (valid UTF-8, one 0x00 byte) and cannot be confused with the domain separator's NUL.
Semantic-version build metadata is exact text: '1.0.0+build.7' in fields 4 and 5 is not normalized to '1.0.0'.

version_id = U+001C (INFORMATION SEPARATOR FOUR). Not whitespace under .NET char.IsWhiteSpace / string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace (Python str.isspace wrongly says it is), so it is VALID and encoded as the single byte 0x1c.

wrong_encoding_controls.description: Domain written as backslash + '0' (two bytes 0x5c 0x30) instead of one NUL byte.
Domain without the trailing NUL byte.
Field 7 as the 64 ASCII hex characters instead of the 32 decoded bytes.
Field 2 as the enum name 'Records' (DefinitionKind.ToString()) instead of the token 'records'.
Field 2 as the enum value '8' instead of the token 'records'.
Domain separator length-prefixed like a field (it is not).
Fields 7 and 8 swapped (schema ID before digest).

invalid_inputs.description: Lone high surrogate (U+D800) at the end of tenant: no UTF-8 encoding exists.
Reversed surrogate pair (U+DC00 U+D800) in record_type_id.
Definition digest with mixed case: the final character replaced by uppercase 'A'.
Definition digest containing a non-hex character 'g'.
Definition digest with a trailing space (65 characters); never trimmed.
Definition digest with a leading space; never trimmed.
Definition digest using a FULLWIDTH DIGIT ZERO (U+FF10) in place of '0': only ASCII 0-9 a-f are hex digits.
Definition digest with a trailing LF (Regex '$' trap).
Missing (null) version_id: a bound/2 entry without Row.PublicationVersionId.
schema_id = U+3000 U+2028 (IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE, LINE SEPARATOR): whitespace under .NET.

invalid_stored_hash.description: Stored Binding.Hash in uppercase hex for V01 inputs.
Stored Binding.Hash is V01's hash but the row's schema_id is V04's ('schema:example-b'): recomputation mismatch.
Stored Binding.Hash is V01's hash but Row.PublicationVersionId is '1.0.1' (V06 inputs): recomputation mismatch.

journal_structure_cases.base: Base B: {"Format":"records-write-file-journal/2","LegacyEntryCount":1,"Entries":[L,W]} where L = {"Tag":"legacy/1","Legacy":<valid /1 entry, key K1>} and W = a valid bound/2 entry (key K2) whose Row carries V01 inputs including Row.PublicationVersionId = "1.0.0". Binding has exactly Encoding and Hash; Binding.Hash = V01 binding_hash. B itself MUST be accepted.
journal_structure_cases.rule: Each reject MUST fail constructor, FindAsync(key), FindAsync(tenant, recordId) and CommitAsync with InvalidDataException and leave the file's SHA-256 unchanged.

whitespace_rule.definition: Frozen format set listed here, independent of runtime classification; reject exactly when every UTF-16 code unit is in this set. No trimming or normalization.
not_whitespace_examples: U+001C-U+001F (Python isspace says yes; .NET says no)

conversion_refusal_cases.scope: Qualification descriptions, not executed decoder/conversion tests. Scan complete source UTF-8 bytes and every JSON member-name/string-value token, including ignored root and nested object/array members, before any file creation/write. Base64 payload strings are scanned, decoded application bytes remain opaque. /1 reads are unchanged. Use pinned old-reader acceptance receipts and disposable source copies; refusal leaves original byte-identical and publishes no /2.
